claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes identity and Army entry, not the date or terms of OSS service.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Frank M. Carrolll in Box 109 without a rank or restricted identifier. The unusual three-l spelling is preserved. The official Army file has no exact-name row, and official, CIA, Library of Congress, OSS, employment, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches provide no person-specific identity bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 109 to determine whether Carrolll is the personnel file spelling, a typographical variant, or a distinct surname, and to recover identity and pre-OSS chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Vincent N. Carrozzo in Box 110 with a restricted identifier. The official Army file has one exact-name row, but its identifier conflicts with the index. A separate index row names Vincent V. Carrazo as a technician fourth grade in Box 109. Spelling, middle initial, box, and identifier differences prevent a merge, while the similar names justify a possible-duplicate review group.
person_updates.next_action: Compare Boxes 109 and 110 to determine whether the Carrazo and Carrozzo rows represent one person, two people, or an index error, and resolve the conflicting identifier before adopting Army or employment evidence.

research_attempts.query_text: Frank M Carrolll and Carroll spelling variant; visually checked NARA index; Army bulk exact-name review; NARA Catalog context; CIA Reading Room; LoC current API; exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The Army file has no exact Carrolll row. Carroll-spelling military, directory, obituary, and current namesakes lack an OSS and Box 109 bridge, so the indexed spelling is neither corrected nor expanded into a person identity.
research_attempts.research_notes: The three-l index spelling is preserved. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified; no authenticated NARA Catalog request was made.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 109 for the underlying file spelling, identity anchors, and pre-OSS chronology.
